messages:
julia: Heads-up: I'm about to land a multi-PR docs refactor that moves /docs/getting-started to /docs/quickstart and adds redirects. Need a review/merge plan to avoid broken anchors in prod.
omar: Thanks — how many PRs and any strict ordering?
julia: 3 PRs: 1) move files + redirects, 2) update SDK snippets & links, 3) anchor fixes + migration guide. They should land in that order ideally.
sara: If we merge 1 before 2, 2's links will 404 in the preview. Can we rely on branch deploy previews to validate before main?
julia: Yes — I'll request a preview from doc-preview-bot. Also planning to add temporary redirects in PR1 so worst-case we have stable permalinks. Example redirect rule for nginx: `rewrite ^/docs/getting-started$ /docs/quickstart/ permanent;`
nick: Sequencing suggestion: PR1 -> wait for preview + sanity check; PR3 (anchors) can be merged after PR1 preview passes; PR2 (snippets) should be merged last so snippet paths match final locations.
omar: Can we reserve a small merge window tomorrow 10:00-11:00 PST so infra and oncall can be ready? I'll stand by for quick rollback if needed.
julia: @nick can you review PR1? @omar can you own PR3? I'll ask @sara for final sign-off on the migration guide.
nick: I can review PR1 today, will look for missing redirects and any reference updates.
circleci: build passed for PR #2423 — docs preview: https://deploy-preview-2423.docs.redwood.ai (preview will be live for 24h)
julia: Preview link looks mostly good, found a couple broken anchors in `advanced/cli.md` and one link to `sdk/python/installation` that needs updating — I'll add those fixes to PR3.
sara: :thumbsup: Good plan. One request — add a short note in the release notes and the changelog about moved permalinks so partners know to update bookmarks.
julia: Will add changelog entry and open a tiny follow-up PR for release notes once PR1 is merged.
nick: Operational note: after PR1 merges, wait ~5 minutes for CDN invalidation then merge PR3, then PR2. I'll tag infra for cache flush if we see stale content.
jarvis: reminder: please include redirects in the PR description and mention the preview URL so support can triage any reports quickly.
